name: Future
overview: Scripture reveals that while human plans and devices abound, it is the counsel and direction of the LORD that ultimately stands and guides our steps, assuring a future grounded in His sovereign will (Proverbs 16:9; 19:21). Believers are encouraged to trust God's Word as a lamp illuminating their path through uncertain times (Psalms 119:105) and to find strength and renewal as they patiently wait upon the Lord (Isaiah 40:31). God's intentions for His people are characterized by peace and hope, promising an expected and secure end (Jeremiah 29:11), even as life’s seasons of prosperity and adversity reveal His divine purpose (Ecclesiastes 7:14).
